messages:
luca: Quick sync: we have v4p1-q4 AB results. Need to decide rollout gate so we don't flip-flop. Short summary + gate idea below.
maria: Ran shadow + seeded eval (20k). Key deltas (B = v4p1-q4 vs A = prod):
- EM mean: A=78.4% | B=78.7% (+0.3)
- Detected hallucinations: A=1.2% | B=1.9% (+0.7)
- p95 latency: A=290ms | B=230ms (-60ms)
- token_cost: B ~ -18%
- concordance_overall: A=0.913 | B=0.901 (-0.012)
- concordance_longdoc(>1k): A=0.88 | B=0.82 (-0.06)
maria: run id `eval-172915-20k-v4p1`. Bootstrap CI on halluc delta ~ +/-0.25, so longdoc drop is concerning.
vikram: Summary: faster and cheaper, tiny EM uptick, but higher hallucination and much weaker longdoc concordance. Not safe to blindly promote.
vikram: Suggestion: streak-based gate during canary with explicit tiebreakers. Rough rules:
- compute rolling 1h windows (10m step). A window PASS if either: (halluc_delta <= +0.4 AND em_delta >= -0.2) OR concordance_overall >= 0.9.
- require 3 PASS windows in a row to increase traffic.
- if a single non-pass window occurs, evaluate tiebreakers in order: concordance_longdoc delta, hallucination_delta, em_delta. If concordance_longdoc delta <= -0.03 block.
- immediate auto-rollback if 2 consecutive windows with halluc_delta > +0.8 OR em_delta < -0.5.
jen: I like the streak. For longform customers prefer a rule that biases toward conservatism: if concordance_longdoc delta > -0.03 AND halluc_delta < +0.6 favor B; else prefer A. That prevents small noise from swinging.
jen: Rollout plan to implement: 5% for 30m (collect overlapping windows), if streak achieved -> 20% for 60m, then 100%.
luca: Ops config snippet to put in promo job: ```
streak_gate:
  window: 1h
  step: 10m
  required_streak: 3
  pass_conditions:
    - (halluc_delta <= 0.4 and em_delta >= -0.2)
    - concordance_overall >= 0.9
  tiebreaker_order: [concordance_longdoc, hallucination_delta, em_delta]
  longdoc_priority_threshold: -0.03
  rollback_triggers:
    - consecutive_windows: 2
      condition: halluc_delta > 0.8
    - consecutive_windows: 2
      condition: em_delta < -0.5
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary `promo/v4p1-q4` scheduled in 20m. Will stop and notify on rollback triggers. dashboard: https://console.internal/reports/eval-172915
maria: Ops note: longdoc sample variance is high; recommend a follow-up longdoc run (50k docs) before increasing beyond 5%.
vikram: Action items: 1) maria -> kick off `eval-longdoc-50k-172915` 2) jen -> add streak_gate block to promo job PR 3) luca -> schedule and ping oncall. I'll open PR #8427 to include the gate.
jen: @safety-bot please wire a short-window hallucination alert (10m sliding) and a longer persistence P0 if >15m.
safety-bot: safety-bot: ack. Will attach alert: absolute halluc_rate > 0.5 OR delta > +0.3 over 10m; persist >15m -> P0.
luca: Merging gate config in 5 unless objections. tagging oncall @kevin.
kevin: oncall ack. I'll monitor the first 2 windows and can flip traffic to A if anything odd.
jen: We'll hold manual promotion if the longdoc-50k job flags a significant drop.
